scope: KNHANES 2021-2024, ages 19-39, noninvasive current metabolic abnormality screening

interpretation.seed_mean: Mean of three separately fitted seed metrics; predictions are not ensembled. LR and Ridge are seedless and repeated only to align paired comparisons.
interpretation.factorial: Fixed primary backbone configuration across eight conditions. OFAT and interactions are conditional effects, not evidence of independent optimality in each condition. No condition is selected by test performance.
interpretation.LR_four_arms: LR is separately fitted and C-selected on clean validation for basic/engineered x clean/paired20. The four-arm comparison and paired contrasts are prespecified; no test-best LR condition is selected.
interpretation.calibration: Common v18 monotone component calibration plus one gamma in Frechet bounds. gamma=0 restores independent q0. Gamma does not change component probabilities or component AP, but it can change between-person q0 ranking and any-event AP. A positive component slope preserves ranking only within the same fold and fitted calibrator; a zero slope can create ties. Different fold calibrators can change cross-fold ranking and pooled OOF component AP. Any-event AP changes cannot be assigned to EPF structure alone.
interpretation.screening: 90%/95% cutoffs selected independently for raw q0 and adjusted q on separate threshold role, fixed before test. Held-out ROC specificity at matched sensitivity is descriptive only.
interpretation.outcome: Four metabolic flags can co-occur; measured labs and blood pressure are targets only, not input features.
interpretation.prior_exploration: Post-hoc correction after repeated examination of the same KNHANES 2021-2024 cohort, including v19; exploratory, not independent or confirmatory validation.
interpretation.mask_correction: WC and derived WHtR share one Bernoulli draw at each nominal missing rate. Other view values and nonwaist draws follow v19. Old/new missing20 has different actual WC mask intensity.
interpretation.fairness: At each view all models receive the same people, raw19 input corruption, labels, roles and survey weights. Clean v19 fits are reused exactly; paired20 fits are retrained under corrected masks.
interpretation.noise: Gaussian 10/25 means additive sigma equal to 10/25 percent of fit-role measurement SD on every observed selected measurement, not a fraction of people.

survey.method: n_h-1 draws with replacement; multiplicity*n_h/(n_h-1); full survey PSUs; no FPC

uncertainty.scope: Paired full-frame PSU bootstrap of fixed OOF predictions, conditional on fitted models
uncertainty.limitations: No full retraining uncertainty, multiplicity correction, external cohort, or independent confirmation
uncertainty.reuse: Post-hoc mask correction after v16/v18/v19 exploration on the same KNHANES cohort; intervals are exploratory and conditional on fixed OOF predictions.
uncertainty.contrast_design: The same 44 clean-view factorial contrasts and seven metrics as v19 are repeated. Neural selection remains frozen by fold from v19; paired LR C is reselected on clean validation using the same grid. No test-based choice.

legacy_comparison.interpretation: The same clean-fitted models saw different WC/WHtR mask intensity. The old/new missing20 delta is not equal-intensity robustness evidence. Paired20 models additionally changed training inputs and were refit.

new_training_cost.note: Only corrected paired20 neural/LR fits are new. The 210 clean evaluation units reuse v19 fits; their archived fit_seconds are not v20 training cost. Shared-device times are not a speed ranking.

unit_origins.origin: v19 clean source files SHA-256 and fingerprint checked
